proof: For an undirected graph, horizon n-1 reaches the entire connected component of each node.
If the largest component fraction L exceeds 0.5, a strict majority of nodes have horizon-reachable fraction L, so the median horizon-reachable fraction is L.
The v1 horizon-realization ratio is therefore exactly 1 for every world with LCC fraction greater than 0.5.
An adequacy-complete ladder containing a 0.75, 0.90, or higher LCC world must therefore predict at least one world survives at any cutoff <= 1.
Consequently falsified_universe cannot be predicted under the frozen v1 horizon/world-construction contract even though it is an allowed scientific outcome.
secondary_failure: LCC target levels can collapse to identical adjacency operators, and counting those duplicate operators as distinct worlds weights the survival fraction by labels rather than distinct structural hypotheses.
consequence: Do not use protocol_v1 for biological response validation. Preserve it as a failed pre-response method attempt.
